1.explanation: These files are key bug files because they directly handle the rendering and behavior of the Menu, SubMenu, and Group components. The Menu component (menu.jsx) is responsible for managing the overall structure and state of the menu, while the SubMenu (sub-menu.jsx) and Group (group.jsx) components define how child elements are rendered and interacted with. Any issues related to how children are recognized and rendered, especially concerning spaces, will likely be found and need to be addressed in these files.
1.bug_scenario: [Menu]Group/SubMenu空格识别为多个children 导致报错. The issue arises when the Menu component incorrectly interprets spaces in the Group/SubMenu as multiple children, leading to errors in rendering or functionality.
